audio.microphoneMessage: The sound server did not answer, so no microphone can be opened.

error.message: Choose or restore a configuration in setup.

backblaze-b2.deletionEffect: Deletes exactly the uploaded B2 file version by its ID. put.gd never uploads over a visible file, so the name then shows nothing, or an older version that was hidden before the upload. Authorized links stop working when they expire.

custom-http.deletionEffect: Asks the server to delete this upload through the deletion URL it returned with the link. What the server removes, and how soon the link stops working, is up to the server.

proton-drive.deletionEffect: Safe remote deletion is unavailable: Proton does not expose an atomic revision-guarded file deletion. Revoke share links separately.

s3.deletionEffect: Guarded origin removal; selected versions only; browser/CDN caches may retain bytes

keyboardHelp.text:
[ / ]: Cycle marks
Arrows: Move
Shift+arrows: Resize
Ctrl+arrows: Move 10 px
Ctrl+Shift+arrows: Resize 10 px
Tab: Focus properties
Delete: Remove mark
Escape: Deselect
Insert: Place mark
Shift+drag: Square, circle, 45° line
Ctrl+Z: Undo
Ctrl+Shift+Z: Redo
Ctrl+Shift+C: Copy image

view.selection: No marks. Insert places a redaction in the middle. Alt+arrow keys pan the image; Alt+Shift+arrow keys pan farther.
